title.narrative: The Advocacy and Communication section amplified children's voices through storytelling, media engagement, digital platforms, youth participation and technical support, empowering children to shape the child rights agenda and actions. The section also facilitated high-level donor visits and supported UNICEF's participation in UN Day, further strengthening visibility and partnerships.
